blocks.text: K-pop supergroup BTS took home four major awards during the first day of the 2026 Melon Music Awards (MMA), held at Gocheok Sky Dome in Seoul, South Korea, on Saturday, Nov. 14. BTS won Album of the Year (Daesang) for its album “ARIRANG.” They also won Global TOP10, Top 10 Artists (Bonsang), and Stage of the Year for its “ARIRANG” World Tour, giving the group four awards in total. However, the group was not present at the ceremony due to its ongoing world tour. Girl group aespa received the Global-K Artist of the Year award, a newly introduced grand prize category […]...
